baseline_comparison.result: All six failures reproduced in pre-feature HEAD, with only the same two Motion LP64 compile fixes and local FFmpeg 8 profile-name aliases; same Qt/runtime and synthetic media fixtures.

limitations: Single observations, no percentile, speed guarantee or minimum hardware requirement.
CPU and GPU samples were collected in separate runs; other regression/build activity was present during this session.
GPU total includes explicit verification readback; it is not a GPU-only timer. Context was already initialized by earlier suite cases.
Qt LinguistTools and matching FFmpeg development headers were extracted to temporary local storage, without system installation or repository dependency changes.
Local CMake used a temporary FFmpeg discovery module and build-only FF_PROFILE_ to AV_PROFILE_ aliases for the installed FFmpeg 8 runtime.
Two Motion LP64 integer-type compile fixes were needed for actual Hub/consumer targets; no application version was advanced.
Six broader Linux regression failures are documented in the feature contract and compared against pre-feature source.
Windows/macOS, packaged runtime, owner visual checks and the controlled Windows reference-PC measurements remain pending.
